summary: Read the inventory reservation path. In packages/modules/inventory/src/services/inventory-module.ts, ensureInventoryLevels checks each reservation entry alone against available_quantity (validateQuantityAtLocation loop, around lines 173-192) and never sums entries that share an inventory item and location. reserveInventoryStep (packages/core/core-flows/src/cart/steps/reserve-inventory.ts) calls createReservationItems under a per-item lock, so the batch check is the only guard and it is per-line. This supports the per-line-check cause from the report. I also saw that createReservationItems_ writes reserved_quantity as an absolute value computed from a prior read (around lines 292-307), which matches the stale-counter-write pattern, but I did not test it. Submitted one attempt (multi-line shared WIDGET, stock 10, 5 pieces vs 3 pieces + 2 two-packs) targeting no_oversell; its result has not been reported to me, so I am not claiming it as confirmed. Budget remains: 29 attempts, 93 turns.
